mapper.select: select v.car_number as carNumber,to_char(p.enter_time, 'YYYY"년" MM"월" DD"일" HH24"시"MI"분"') as enterTime from vehicle v, parking_record p where v.car_number = p.car_number and p.exit_time is null

select car_number as carNumber,to_char(enter_time, 'YYYY"년" MM"월" DD"일" HH24"시"MI"분"') as enterTime, to_char(exit_time, 'YYYY"년" MM"월" DD"일" HH24"시"MI"분"') as exitTime from parking_record where exit_time is not null
select id, car_number carNumber, to_char(expire_date, 'YYYY"년" MM"월" DD"일"') expireDate, REGEXP_REPLACE(phone_number, '([0-9]{3})([0-9]{3,4})([0-9]{4})', '\1-\2-\3') cellphone, name from member
mapper.insert: insert into member (car_number, expire_date, phone_number, name) values (#{carNumber}, systimestamp + interval '1' month, #{cellphone}, #{name})
mapper.update: update member set car_number = #{carNumber}, name = #{name}, phone_number = #{cellphone} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select id, car_number as carNumber, phone_number as cellphone, name from member where id = #{id}
select car_number from member where car_number = #{carNumber}
mapper.insert: insert into parking_record (car_number, enter_time, fee) VALUES (#{carNumber}, systimestamp,0)
mapper.select: select enter_time from parking_record where car_number = #{carNumber}
